description: ACC earners' levy (New Zealand) [NZ]. ACC earners' levy for 2026-27: 1.75% of earnings up to the maximum liable earnings of $156,641 (GST inclusive). For employees it is deducted through PAYE. Doesn't cover work levies, the self-employed minimum earnings, or part-year earnings.

earnings.description: Annual liable earnings in NZD (salary or self-employed income)
